frozenBefore.policy: Every recorded application/server/config/lockfile/fixture/font/dependency input and generated bundle/style output must match the frozen build. Server pinning does not imply that backend endpoints ran in the browser.

frozenAfter.policy: Every recorded application/server/config/lockfile/fixture/font/dependency input and generated bundle/style output must match the frozen build. Server pinning does not imply that backend endpoints ran in the browser.

limitations: The actual builder and local text inspection/index code are composed offline with injected synthetic SourceJob responses; signed-in navigation, real provider interpretation and persistence are not exercised.
Text attachment inspection is real. The physical/printed PDF page scenario uses original synthetic extracted-page strings, not the user PDF or a PDF parser.
Chromium viewport emulation does not establish physical iOS/iPadOS behavior.
